text:
Maya (CEO): Quick follow-up thread from today's all-hands — drop short clarifying Qs about mission/positioning and we'll reply through the day.

Nina (Marketing): For website hero, should we lead with 'inference platform' or 'infrastructure for models'? Need one tight phrase.

Maya (CEO): Lead with user benefit. Suggest: 'Inference that behaves like infrastructure: predictable, observable, and cost-aware.' Shorten as needed for the hero.

Jon (CTO): For tech calls: emphasize runtime guarantees (SLOs), routing/fallback, and measurable unit economics. Customers care about predictable latency more than novelty.

Ben (BizOps): Sales trigger question: what's the clean threshold for handing a customer to sales for Dedicated/Private?

Priya (Head of Product): Current rule: sustained >$5k/mo or repeated SLA breaches (p95 > target) or explicit compliance asks (PII/regulatory). Priya to formalize playbook.

Sam (Growth): Can marketing publish any performance numbers now? We need conservative, sign-off-ready lines.

Maya (CEO): Use conservative examples only: "median request latency ~100ms on common decoder models; typical TCO savings 30-50% vs unmanaged fleets." Legal/Finance will bless specifics.

Nina (Marketing): Got it — will prepare copy with conservative language and "illustrative" tag if needed.

Jon (CTO): Small demo snippet for sales to show routing fallback:
```
policy:
  priority: [latency, cost]
  fallback: quantized_small
  canary: 5%
```
Pasteable, shows graceful degradation.

AllHandsBot: Slides + recording uploaded: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/2267800123/recording

Maya (CEO): Thanks — action items: Priya publish playbook triggers, Jon share demo snippets in Sales folder, Nina draft hero copy, Ben update the enterprise checklist. I'll follow up if anything blocks. :raised_hands:
